value: US EPA (2019). Global Non-CO2 Greenhouse Gas Emission Projections & Mitigation: 2015-2050. EPA-430-R-19-010. U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Office of Atmospheric Programs, Washington, DC.

NO TECHNOLOGY PARAMETERS EXTRACTED. A 76-page summary (43 PDF pages, two printed pages per sheet) of EPA's global non-CO2 projections. The nitric and adipic acid section (printed pp.26-29) names the modelled N2O measures (thermal destruction; catalytic decomposition in the burner; tail-gas catalytic decomposition; NSCR; homogeneous decomposition) in words only, with sector totals (2030 baseline 270 MtCO2e, abatement potential 231 MtCO2e, 86%). No reduction efficiency, capex, opex or lifetime per measure. The MAC inputs are in the separate methodology report EPA-430-R-19-012 (added to to-get.csv 2026-10-01). Out-of-scope numbers: HCFC-22 thermal oxidation (95%, ~20 yr, ~$5.2M retrofit / $4M new / $0.4M restart, ~$200k/yr O&M, per plant, no price year), electronics F-gas abatement (95-99%), magnesium SF6 alternatives (95-100%).
